tagline.en: All your balls drop together, into brand-new buckets.
tagline.id: Semua bola jatuh bersamaan, ke wadah yang baru.

items.en: Plinko: up to 16 balls now fall at the same time instead of one by one. They settle as one round: your payout is the bet × the sum of every ball.
items.id: Plinko: sampai 16 bola sekarang jatuh bersamaan, tidak satu per satu lagi. Semua dihitung satu ronde: hadiah = taruhan × jumlah pengali semua bola.

items.en: New multiplier buckets: 3D blocks that glow from gold in the middle to red at the edges, line up exactly under the pegs and bounce when a ball lands.
items.id: Wadah pengali baru: balok 3D bergradasi emas di tengah sampai merah di pinggir, pas di bawah pasak, dan memantul saat bola masuk.
